title: lane r7 SE: dual-form grammar lacks grandfathering semantics
description: Lane round 7. Lens: SE (validator: SO). Owner: SO session. Defect: whether a pre-sync branch becomes off-grammar after sync is undecidable — reading (ii) false-positives every legacy branch. Citations verified: contract:124. Proposed: resolved-candidate (a branch keeps the form lawful at its creation; sync never retroactively obligates a rename; the query keys on creation-time validity).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed: a branch keeps whichever form was lawful at creation; sync never retroactively obligates a rename — creation-time validity is the query's key. Revision: Conformance bullet.
